sv_name.description: The name displayed in the server browser.

sv_port.description: The server port for player connections.

sv_bindaddr.description: The IP address to bind the server to.

sv_external_port.description: Port to connect to the master server. 0 means default.

sv_max_clients_per_ip.description: Maximum number of allowed players per IP address.

sv_high_bandwidth.description: Set to 1 for LAN server mode (high bandwidth optimization).

sv_register.description: Register with the master server. Set to 1 to enable.

password.description: Password required for players to join the server.

sv_rcon_max_tries.description: Maximum number of RCON password retries before ban.

sv_rcon_ban_time.description: RCON password ban time in minutes.

sv_motd.description: Message of the day displayed to players.

sv_vote_kick_bantime.description: Ban time in minutes after a successful vote kick.

sv_vote_kick_min.description: Minimum number of players required to trigger a vote kick.

sv_inactivekick_time.description: Time in minutes a player is allowed to be inactive before being kicked.

sv_inactivekick.description: Action for inactive players: 0=move to spectator, 1=move to free spectator slot, 2=kick.

sv_teambalance_time.description: Time in minutes after which teams are auto-balanced if uneven.

logfile.description: Path to the server log file.

exec_path.description: Path to the included default configuration file.
